accepted_properties: Retained episode identity, silver-blue/purple palettes and existing character voices.
scope.limitations: Decoded stills and ordered frames, not realtime viewing or listening. Mostly front and three-quarter angles; no complete walk cycle or rear coverage.

iterations.change: Independent wind-gorge stage, cargo objective and new Suno cue. Preview rock occlusion and sky streaks were repaired.
iterations.result: Final frames show cargo protection before the cut. Face, hair and load performance remain weak.

misses.prior_judgment: Recovery R3 focused on craft restoration but incorrectly reused the previous palace and music.
misses.later_finding: User required episode-specific story, setting and music unless continuity justifies reuse.
misses.lesson: Separate reusable craft from prior-episode content; verify actual audio hashes.

reviewer_conclusion: Independent episode content was implemented; character art remains unapproved. Pending coverage is not passed. No claim of exceeding S1E2 or the external reference.
encoding_repair_note: On the hair-study turn, question marks caused by the earlier Windows pipe encoding were detected. Observation text was restored in English from the existing windsieve REVIEW.md and reviewed evidence; no new pass or fix status was assigned.
